finding.evidence: Server: Apache/2.4.29 (Ubuntu) PHP/7.2.24; X-Powered-By: PHP/7.2.24 WooCommerce/3.5.1
finding.description: The stack and its versions are announced to anyone.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: version-disclosure (The stack and its versions are announced to anyone. Evidence: Server: Apache/2.4.29 (Ubuntu) PHP/7.2.24; X-Powered-By: PHP/7.2.24 WooCommerce/3.5.1). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Recommended fix for version-disclosure supported by cited OWASP page: Remove all X-Powered-By headers. The verified page text does not include ServerTokens Prod, ServerSignature Off, expose_php = off, or a generic Server value, so those specific directives are omitted from this fix.

fix.summary: Remove Server and X-Powered-By version disclosure headers from HTML responses.
fix.risk: Clients relying on Server or X-Powered-By headers for diagnostics would no longer see them.
